scenes.text: {{TITLE}}. In one minute you will create an account, install the tool, and run your first project.
Step one. Create your account. Type your email and a password, then press Sign up.
Step two. Open a terminal and run this one command to install the tool.
Tip. Use the same email on every device, and your projects follow you.
That's it. Your account is ready, the tool is installed, and you are ready for your first project.
Next, build your first page. Go to example dot com slash start.
